correctness.rationale: A derivation annihilates 1 and restricts to B-skew-adjoint D on V; Jordan invertibility of a nonzero pure vector is exactly B(w,w)≠0. Even alternating rank plus the finite-field isotropy theorem forces nonzero anisotropic image dimension 2. Such W supports q−1 nonzero skew maps, one class per nonsquare eta with two maps per plane. Witt transitivity and O(V) stabilizer orders yield the exact odd/even dimension formulas, including n=2 split zero. Independent enumeration of all skew matrices for q=3,5, n=2,3 and two form types recovered counts and eta fibers.
